decisions.reason: As a newly launched product in the firm’s core underground-equipment business with no visible sign of underperformance yet, management would likely keep it while using its engineering and service slack to learn from the market rather than trigger early problemistic search.

Because this dump truck line also fits the firm’s established underground mining portfolio and there is no clear evidence that results fall below aspiration levels, a behavioral-firm management would most likely continue it for now, though with some caution due to the costs and uncertainty of new product introduction.
